idle.description: Sitting calmly: breathing, twitching nose, ear flick

sniff.description: Sniffing: head up, nose and whiskers twitch

walk.description: Walking: small steps, body low, slight sway

popcorn.description: Popcorning: happy jump with a twist and a kick

eat.description: Eating hay: chewing, a strand pulled into the mouth

scratch.description: Scratching behind the ear with a hind paw

wake_up.description: Getting up, stretching and yawning (teeth showing)

dance.description: Dancing to music: swaying and nodding to the beat

held.description: Picked up with the mouse: legs dangle and paddle

front_idle.description: Looking at you: breathing, nose, ear

turn.description: Turning from side view to front

peek.description: Peeking from behind the screen edge and hiding

drink.description: Drinking from the bottle: head up, licks the spout, bubbles in the bottle

chew_stick.description: Chewing a stick: wears down teeth, shavings fall

dig_hay.description: Digging in hay: dives in, strands fly, comes out with hay in the mouth

chin_rub.description: Scent marking: rubs the chin along the floor, stretching

eat_big.description: Tugging a big lettuce leaf and chewing

beg.description: Begging for a treat: stands on hind legs, nose working

stand_up.description: Trick: stands up and looks around

sad.description: Sad: head low, ears back, sits hunched

sick.description: Sick: ruffled fur, half-closed eyes, trembling

poop.description: Poop: squats, leaves a poop and walks on

heat_flop.description: Heat: lies flat with hind legs stretched back

sleep_house.description: Sleeping in the house: only the nose sticks out

purr_pet.description: Purring when petted: relaxes, eyes squinted, hearts

rumble.description: Rumblestrut: hip sway with a rumble (courtship, dominance)

flee.description: Fleeing: full speed, ears back, dust from the paws

greet.description: Greeting: ears up, "wheee!" and a happy jump

come_called.description: Coming when called: ears up, looks at you and starts running

hurdle.description: Agility: jumps over an obstacle (the game moves the pig over it)

house_enter.description: Goes into the house (house on the right, pig disappears inside)

house_exit.description: Comes out of the house (house on the left)

tunnel_in.description: Runs into the tunnel (tunnel on the right), then the tunnel moves

tunnel_wiggle.description: Pig in the tunnel: a bulge moves along the tunnel

tunnel_out.description: Runs out of the tunnel (tunnel on the left)

ball_push.description: Pushes the ball with the nose and follows it

nose_touch.description: Nose to nose with another pig (two pigs facing each other)

follow.description: Following the other pig (same as walk)

sleep_together.description: Sleeping cuddled up to the other pig (head stretched out, flat)

party.description: Birthday: party hat, celery cake and confetti

chirp.description: Chirping: high, quiet sound (typical for babies)
